notes:
PASS on the fake backend; the real TDW-MAT environment was not installed or run (it needs Python 3.9, an editable install, a ThreeDWorld build, an X server, tdw==1.11.23.5 and downloaded transport-challenge asset bundles), and the sim path (gymnasium.make) was not run. The runnable model is the package fake: an analytic F0 stand-in, not ThreeDWorld. Its arrays are reduced to 2x2 (real sizes: rgb 3 x screen_size x screen_size, seg_mask screen_size x screen_size x 3, depth screen_size x screen_size, screen_size default 512); visible-object ids, camera matrix, object positions and scene are placeholders, and empty slots use -1 where upstream pads with None. The fake accepts a seed-only reset with a placeholder scene, while upstream requires options['scene'] and options['layout'] and reads ./dataset/name_map.json and ./dataset/room_types.json. It uses Python random.Random rather than numpy's RandomState, so a seed repeats fake trajectories but not upstream ones. The action contract is the environment's declared single-agent action_space_single: upstream action_space is built from observation_space_single (bug), and the bridge limit-path grammar cannot address an agent-id key '0' (LimitConfigError: bad limit path 'action.0.type'), so the fake wraps the single action under agent '0' for TDW.step's agent map and only the default one-agent configuration is served. The declared message Text space publishes as an open object because the bridge has no string kind. Expected warnings left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (a seed only affects the next reset) and six G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.type, action.object, action.arm, reset.seed, seed.seed). No hardware and no network were used. NOT COVERED: the real TDW arrays, TDW physics and contacts, rendering and top-down images, the dataset scene files, multi-agent coordination, and the sim backend.
